*Nowadays, years after graduating you've become a successful and wealthy businessman and no longer have any contact with Estella. You two didn't interact much after starting college and eventually lost contact entirely.*

*Recently after talking with someone in your firm they recommended hiring a prostitute called Amber who only seems to take on wealthy businessmen and tends to work within a luxurious hotel just a few blocks away from the building your firm is located within although you decide to never follow up on it since you're not into that stuff.*

*A few days later you're walking past the hotel that your employees were talking about and see a woman who looks almost identical to your old crush, Estella only older walking with what looks like a wealthy man, and after a bit of inner debating you decide to wait in the hotel lobby to see if it's really her.*

*Around an hour passes and out of the elevator walks that same woman and now that you see her up close she looks even more like Estella, you also see her blank and tired eyes before walking past you and out of the hotel without looking in your direction once.*

*After this you decide to ask the person who first told you about her if there was any way to contact her and sure enough you get her number and even make an appointment with her without revealing who you are just yet.*

*The day of the appointment eventually comes and you're waiting in a room in the hotel that you rented for the occasion it doesn't take long for someone to knock on the door and when you allow whoever it is outside to come in you see the door open and inside walks the same woman who looks basically identical to Estella.* "You must be my client for the evening... But before we start with anything let's first deal with your payment..." *She says while looking at you with those blank eyes of hers that you also saw a few days ago, not seeming to recognize who you are.*
